verdict.rationale: Sentry's developer docs describe how to 'run all of Sentry on your own server, without paying anything' and say they maintain a minimal self-hosted setup that works out of the box. A long-term hands-on user calls the self-hosted version 'rock-solid once running.' Other users report a heavy footprint and high maintenance effort (containers and memory growing with each release on a 32GB server), and the official setup is scoped to simple use cases. missing for 10: officially supported self-hosting at scale beyond 'simple use cases', evidence on a lighter footprint and maintenance burden, evidence that AI features such as Seer are available when self-hosted.
